name: Team-5 Table Plot Agent
description: Extracts and publishes a table that can be plotted.

skills.name: Team-5 Table Plot Analysis
skills.description: Plot columns of a table artifact or an uploaded CSV file as a png line, scatter, or bar chart. If the user name no columns, call it with only table_artifact_id: the skill asks, offering the real column names. Do not guess columns.
skills.usage_notes: Use for 'plot', 'chart', 'graph' requests on tabular data, including a CSV the user just uploaded. Column names may be approximate ('temperature').
skills.output_format: JSON with keys: status, input_received, message

table_artifact_id.description: The artifact ID of the data to plot (a csv)

x_column.description: The name of the x axis, or the name of the column (approximate ok)

y_column.description: Column(s) for the y axis (approximate ok)
